title: Monkey waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 70 Q92 68 88 50 Q86 40 78 42" fill="none" stroke="#8a5a2b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="68" rx="18" ry="20" fill="#a9703a"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="72" rx="11" ry="13" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="88" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="88" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <path d="M36 62 Q24 70 26 82" fill="none" stroke="#a9703a" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving right arm up -->
  <path d="M68 60 Q82 54 84 38" fill="none" stroke="#a9703a" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx="85" cy="35" r="7" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <!-- fingers -->
  <circle cx="79" cy="30" r="2.6" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="27" r="2.6" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="31" r="2.6" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="40" r="2.6" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="9" fill="#a9703a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="5" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="40" r="9" fill="#a9703a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="40" r="5" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="20" fill="#a9703a"/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="14" ry="13" fill="#e8c79b"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="39" r="3.4" fill="#3a2416"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="39" r="3.4" fill="#3a2416"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M43 51 Q50 57 57 51" fill="none" stroke="#8a5a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
